name: Chemical Promotion Development Scheme
benefit:
The scheme extends soft support in the form of Grants-in-Aid (General) to various organisations and industry associations to conduct workshops, seminars, and studies.
##### ***Component I (Creation of Knowledge Products)***

- The financial support provided to industry associations for conducting studies or preparing industry reports will not exceed 50% of the cost or ₹7,50,000/-, whichever is low
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a Government agency (such as an autonomous body, Public Sector Undertaking, or government academic institution), an association of industry in the chemicals and petrochemicals sector, or a specialized organisation. - The applicant must not be an event manager. - The applicant must comply with the provisions of General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017 as applicable. - The applicant must comply with the instructions regarding the Expenditure, Advance, Transfer (EAT) Module of the Public Financial Management System (PFMS). ##### ***For Non-Governmental Entities*** - The applicant must be registered with NITI Aayog. - The applicant must obtain a Unique ID before applying for financial assistance under the scheme. ##### ***For Specialized Organisations*** - The applicant must have demonstrated expertise in the field in which the proposed event is to be organized. - The applicant must have been working for at least five years. - The applicant must have successfully organised knowledge dissemination events in the chemicals or petrochemicals sector in previous years.
